title: Qwen3.8-Omni: Towards Native Omni-Modal Agents
data_curation: Pretraining stage S2 uses ~2.5T tokens: text 1.1T, audio 0.7T (monaural plus multichannel), image 0.35T, video 0.15T, video-audio 0.3T, with unimodal and cross-modal data mixed from early pretraining and diverse natural-language prompts for instruction generalization. The AuT audio encoder is pretrained on a corpus of 20+ languages (Chinese:English:other = 3.5:3.5:3), supervised by transcripts from a dedicated Qwen ASR model. Post-training data is ChatML-serialized text-only, visual, audio and mixed-modality conversations. Its core is trajectories generated by domain-specialist teachers (instruction following, reasoning, coding, agentic, visual, audio). RL uses interactive environments such as executable code sandboxes and harness-based interfaces. The report gives no post-training dataset sizes. Talker training uses a dedicated balanced-data pipeline plus complex conversational-context corpora.
curriculum: Thinker pretraining runs in four stages, all at a 262,144-token native length. S1 freezes the LLM (initialized from Qwen3.8-Next) and aligns the vision, AuT and Spatial AuT encoders, training the adapters first. S2 unfreezes everything on the 2.5T mix. S3 freezes the backbone and warms up the Qwen Sparse Attention (QSA) indexer with dense-attention supervision. S4 enables QSA and jointly trains backbone and indexer. Post-training has two stages: (1) multi-teacher distillation of specialists into one student, then (2) unified RL. Context is extended from 256K to 1M after post-training. The Talker has its own five stages: pretraining, CPT, per-language experts merged via Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD), speaker fine-tuning, then RL.
method: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash is a Thinker-Talker omni model. The Thinker is a hybrid sparse-MoE backbone that mixes Gated DeltaNet with interleaved attention layers converted to QSA, which uses an indexer over compressed micro-blocks to select context blocks. It takes vision, general-audio AuT (6.25 Hz tokens, 16x conv downsampling) and a new Spatial AuT that reads the complex STFT of first-order-ambisonics audio, all with explicit timestamps. In post-training, specialist teachers are each initialized from the Qwen3.8 base and trained with SFT+RL; their trajectories are distilled into one student to reduce cross-modal and cross-domain interference. Unified RL then rewards task correctness plus interaction quality: cross-modal consistency, natural spoken responses, stable language/persona and long-context instruction following. Agentic rewards come from execution outcomes, not self-reported completion. The Talker (RVQ tokens, MTP residual codebooks, 48 kHz Code2Wav) is optimized with GSPO using rewards from the preference-aligned Thinker.
eval_metrics: Text: DeepSWE 1.1, SWE-bench Pro/Multilingual, NL2Repo, CoWorkBench, IFBench, GPQA-D, HLE, LiveCodeBench v6. Vision: AndroidWorld, ClawEval-MM, Vision2Web, LVBench, MathVision, CharXiv. Audio: multi-speaker ASR (DER/cpWER), FLEURS, MMAU/MMAR/MMSU, music QA, VoiceBench. Audio-visual: OmniVideoBench, Video-MME-v2, LVOmniBench, StreamingBench. Agentic: WildClawBench-MM, UniClawBench, AgenticVBench, OmniGAIA. Realtime: TTFT/TTFC/RTF, voice-cloning WER and speaker similarity. Headlines: SWE-bench Pro 63.3, LiveCodeBench v6 92.6, AndroidWorld 87.1, MathVision 91.8, AliMeeting DER/cpWER 3.4/17.2 (vs 88.1/89.6 for Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus), WildClawBench-MM 71.0 (vs 34.5). Agentic (Qwen Code) inference lifts LVOmniBench from 63.3 to 73.6.
key_results: Against Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus, it raises the average over 29 audio, audio-visual and agent evaluations by more than 25%, while matching the text-only Qwen3.8-Flash (SWE-bench Pro 63.3 vs 62.5; IFBench 81.5 vs 81.3). Agentic evidence gathering on OmniVideoBench raises accuracy from 63.4 to 67.8 and cuts tokens per query by about 45.7% (145,736 to 79,117), and the paper estimates more than 98%/93% lower API input cost per hour of audio/audiovisual content.
evolution_note: This report succeeds Qwen3.5-Omni (Thinker-Talker, AuT) and inherits the Qwen3.8-Next hybrid GDN/sparse-attention MoE backbone. It moves the omni line from perception and chat toward long-horizon agentic productivity, with 1M context and spatial audio. Its post-training follows the 2026 pattern of consolidating SFT+RL specialist teachers through multi-teacher distillation before unified RL, and of GSPO/MOPD for the speech head. Releasing Qwen-MM-Plugins and Qwen-Live-Harness puts the system as much in the harness as in the weights.
